summary: The registrant filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units issued in the IPO may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and rights beginning July 17, 2026. No fractional rights will be issued; only whole rights trade. This is an administrative step in the lifecycle of a SPAC's securities, not a business combination, tender offer, or any other special situation. The filing contains no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor involvement, and no structural or regulatory risk-arb angle.
